label: Nutrition
headline:
Protein at
breakfast
body: Most people get almost none, then crash by 11am. Try: besan chilla + curd, paneer bhurji, eggs, or oats + milk + peanuts.

label: Myth buster
headline:
Crunches burn
belly fat?
body: Nope — you can't spot-reduce fat. Crunches build muscle under the fat, they don't remove it. Belly fat goes when your total body fat drops.

label: Hours of sleep
body:
Deep sleep is when testosterone
releases and hunger hormones reset.
Short nights = cravings, low energy.
Fix sleep, fix half your problems.
